label: Argued in The Essence of Christianity that God is the externalized projection of human species-powers
description: Ludwig Feuerbach formulated and introduced the concept of "Anthropological Projection (Theology as Anthropology)", which became a seminal contribution in mind philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in mind.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 19th Century Divergences as part of Ludwig Feuerbach's canonical writings.

label: Catalyzed Marx's decisive break from Hegelian idealism to historical materialism, prompting Theses on Feuerbach
description: Karl Marx was fundamentally influenced by Ludwig Feuerbach's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Ludwig Feuerbach's perspective to Karl Marx's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 19th Century Divergences era.
